faq.description: Straightforward answers regarding code ownership, delivery timelines, costs, and warranty commitments.

items.question: Who owns the project source code and intellectual property?
items.answer: 100% owned by you. All Git repositories, documentation, and digital assets are fully transferred without royalties or vendor lock-in.

items.question: What is the typical development timeline?
items.answer: Focused MVP systems take 4–8 weeks. For complex enterprise platforms, we work in transparent 2-week sprints with regular demos.

items.question: Does PT Tehnonusa provide post-launch warranty and support?
items.answer: Yes. Every project includes a bug-free maintenance warranty and system availability SLA commitments.

items.question: How are project investment estimates calculated?
items.answer: Priced transparently based on architectural complexity, module integrations, and delivery milestones. We offer free technical discovery sessions to provide a formal proposal.

items.question: Can the new system integrate with our legacy databases?
items.answer: Yes. We specialize in building secure bridge API connectors so your new system connects seamlessly without interrupting live operations.
